The usage limit telling you to sit down is the most relatable line in this 😄 A tip for anyone writing joke songs with AI: the punchline only lands if the model sings your exact words. When we tested Suno V6 it kept 91 to 98% of the typed English lyrics but also added whole verses of its own, so tag every part with [Verse] and [Chorus], keep the lines short, and listen to both takes before picking. We put the same lyrics through four music models on VBN Studio to see which one sticks to the script, vbnstudio.ai
